warnings: Ground-floor lighting plan. Luminaires and switches are tied together by LETTERED SWITCH GROUPS (a to m) -- each letter appears on the switch and again on every luminaire it controls, with a curved line drawn between them.

*** LUMINAIRE COUNTS ON THIS SHEET ARE READ FROM THE DRAWN SYMBOLS, NOT FROM ANY SCHEDULE. *** RE-COUNTED AT HIGH ZOOM 2026-07-28, recording several reversals: the first pass systematically counted each group's solid-dot SWITCH as one of its luminaires and also under-counted the living zone. Corrected counts: a=6 (unchanged), b=1 (previously missed entirely), c-f=10 (was 7: c2/d2/e3/f3), g-h=4 (unchanged), i=2 (was 3), j=1 (was 2), k+m=3 (was 5), l=2 (was 3) -- TOTAL 29 fittings on this floor. Symbol key that resolves it: crossed-circle or batten-bar = fitting; small solid dot = switch. There is still no lighting schedule anywhere in the electrical set (EE-01 gives types only), so these counts remain the only quantity source and carry count_read_from_symbols.
The group letters are legible but which luminaire belongs to which group is read at 1:100 and is the least certain part -- flagged group_membership_read_at_page_scale.
THE ENTRANCE SWITCH BANK IS SIX GANGS (a,b,c and d,e,f in two stacks) by the terrace door -- the main switching point for the living areas and the exterior.
GROUP 'a' IS THE EXTERIOR CIRCUIT and it wraps the whole house: north-west corner, both front corners, the east side and the car port. Those are the 2.30 m wall lights from EE-01.
The stair group (j) is switched at top and bottom, which is what EE-01's สวิตซ์ 3 ทาง (two-way switch) entry is for.
Only one mounting level is printed on the plan, +2.30 at the laundry -- everything else relies on EE-01's legend heights.
The consumer unit sits on the wall between ทานอาหาร and จอดรถ, with the home run tagged 1/CU.
